full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph shows a large empty room beneath an undulating, cave-like vaulted ceiling. Smooth pale columns swell upward from both sides and join into broad asymmetrical arches that flow across the top of the frame. The ceiling surface is mottled with faded blue, green, ochre, and terracotta ornament, its old painted texture following the curves rather than forming a rigid grid. At the far wall, a tall arched window with warm wooden framing stands near the center. Smaller circular panes line its lower section, while tiny blue and pink patterned glass pieces fill the upper arch. A second curving window with similar circular lower openings sits at left, partially hidden by a thick column. To the right of the central window, a narrow deep red doorway and another round-edged opening lead into dim adjoining spaces. The lower half of the image is a broad empty parquet floor, polished enough to catch blurred reflections of the windows and columns. The camera is positioned low near one corner, facing the far wall diagonally so the ceiling forms overlap from left to right. Warm daylight enters through the windows, making pale pools on the floor and glowing softly within the colored glass. The deeper right side falls into cool shadow, while small amber wall lights illuminate the darker recesses. Rough speckled plaster, colored fragments, curved wood frames, and smooth flooring give the scene varied tactile surfaces. The overall composition is quiet and organic, with sculptural vaults floating above an open reflective foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形室内照片呈现一间宽敞的空房，顶部是起伏如洞穴的拱顶。两侧平滑浅色立柱向上膨起，汇成横贯画面上方的宽阔不对称拱线。顶面布满褪色蓝、绿、赭和陶土色花纹斑驳，陈旧彩绘肌理顺着曲面流动，而不是形成刻板网格。远墙中央附近立着一扇暖木框的高拱窗。下半部排着较小的圆窗格，上部拱顶则填有细小蓝粉花玻璃。左边第二扇曲线窗也有圆形下部开口，部分被厚柱遮住。中央窗右侧，一道狭窄深红门和另一道圆边开口通往昏暗邻室。画面下半部是一片宽阔空荡的拼花木地板，抛光表面足以接住窗和柱的模糊倒影。相机置于角落附近的低位，斜对远墙，因此顶拱从左向右互相重叠。温暖日光从窗进入，在地面形成浅亮光池，并于彩色玻璃内柔和发亮。较深的右侧落入冷影，几盏小型琥珀壁灯照亮更暗的凹处。粗糙斑点灰泥、彩色碎片、弯曲木框和平滑地板赋予场景多样触感。整体构图安静而有机，雕塑般拱顶漂浮在敞开的反光前景上。
style_prompt_en: The interior photographic style favors flowing, asymmetric curves and tactile surfaces over strict rectilinear order. Broad pale forms rise and merge into organic vaults, with smaller rounded apertures repeating at a human scale. Aged mottled color spreads thinly across textured surfaces: dusty blue, muted green, ochre, and terracotta against warm ivory. Dark wood and amber light provide compact accents. Soft daylight filters through colored translucent areas, producing gentle highlights and blurred reflections on a smooth foreground plane. Deeper recesses retain cool shadow, giving depth without severe contrast. A slightly low, oblique viewpoint lets overlapping curves lead the eye toward a lit center. Fine speckling, faded decoration, and irregular edges preserve a handcrafted quality, while the open lower area gives the composition breathing room. The overall effect is lyrical, sculptural, and warmly inhabited even when the frame is empty.
style_prompt_zh: 这种室内摄影风格偏爱流动的不对称曲线与富触感表面，而非严格直线秩序。宽阔浅色形体升起并汇成有机拱面，较小圆形开口以接近人体的尺度重复。陈旧斑驳的颜色薄薄铺在有肌理的表面：灰蓝、柔绿、赭色和陶土色衬着暖象牙色。深木色与琥珀光形成集中的点缀。柔和日光穿过彩色半透明区域，在平滑前景平面上留下温柔高光与模糊倒影。更深的凹处保留冷影，产生纵深而没有严厉反差。略低且斜向的视点让重叠曲线引导视线到受光中心。细微斑点、褪色装饰和不规则边缘保持手工质感，敞开的下部区域让构图有呼吸空间。整体效果抒情、雕塑感强，即使画面空无一人也有温暖生活气息。
theme_en: An undulating vaulted room with patterned windows and a polished wooden floor
theme_zh: 起伏拱顶、花纹窗与抛光木地板的房间
name: Antoni Gaudi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
